body:
Pre-check for head `e0b968e9f9463479629873255b49fd43442152c7`:

- GitHub reports `MERGEABLE` against `main`.
- The published diff matches the tested local diff. It contains only the regression test and its decision record.
- The final quick gate passes all 10 tests in `default_machine_missing`.
- Strict Clippy passes for all `camcraft-app` targets.
- The controlled text-cache mutation fails at the repaired-file assertion. The restored reader passes.
- The body names the test, commands, mutation result, and unrun lanes.
- Light lane: NOT RUN because it uses release mode outside this bounded validation scope.
- `gh pr checks` reports: `no checks reported on the 'issue/2324-default-machine-disk-pin' branch`.

This is the author's pre-check, not an independent review or a CI pass.
The PR is ready for independent review. Maintainers retain the merge decision.

Independent submission check for head `e0b968e9f9463479629873255b49fd43442152c7`:

- Read the complete diff and the disk reader. The change adds one test to the existing suite and a decision record.
- The test calls `default_machine_checked` with disk files in one isolated process. It checks `Err`, `Err`, `Ok` and preservation of the good parsed machine.
- Inspected the controlled cache mutation and its failure log. The failure occurs at the repaired-file assertion. Production code matches `main`.
- Independently reran `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 10 passed, 0 failed.
- Independently reran `cargo clippy -j 3 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Targeted rustfmt and `git diff --check`: passed. The published diff matches the checked local diff.
- Light lane: NOT RUN. The release-mode lane remains outside the bounded debug-only validation scope.
- Catalog, heavy, release, GUI, Windows, and macOS checks: NOT RUN.
- GitHub reports no checks. This is not a CI pass or physical-machine certification.

No blocking defect was found in this submission check. This contributor comment does not replace collaborator review. Maintainers retain the merge decision.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e0b968e9f9463479629873255b49fd43442152c7 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings. Set `merge-ready` because the review is clean and GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

Read the complete diff, issue #2324 and its comments, the disk reader, and the current laws from `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`.

The test calls the public reader in one isolated process. It checks the missing, empty, repaired, and later broken files. The parent checks that the child ran one test. The change joins an existing suite and adds no dependency.

Local results on macOS:

- Base: `upstream/main` at `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`.
- Worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-4078`, head `e0b968e9f9463479629873255b49fd43442152c7`.
- `git merge --no-edit upstream/main`: already up to date. The base is the PR head's direct parent. No trial merge commit was needed; HEAD remains the PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. `default_machine_missing`: 10 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: passed. All six steps passed, including the release build.
- Motion library light tests: 7 passed, 0 failed.
- Motion light suites `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, and `adaptive_troch_parallel`: 1 passed each, 0 failed.
- App light suite `pocket_pass_start`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `rustfmt --check --edition 2024 crates/app/tests/default_machine_missing/disk_recovery.rs`: passed.
- `git diff upstream/main --check`: passed.

The inherited sccache setup stopped making progress. I interrupted that first command and reran with the wrapper disabled. All completed checks above used that setup. No GitHub runner was used.

Extra suites run: the light suites listed above. The diff changes no test fixture, importer, post, toolpath, motion code, catalog, or UI. The extra fixture, kernel, catalog, golden, and screenshot checks do not apply.

Safety and mutations: this change adds only tests and a decision record. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision check, gouge check, or stock simulation. The safety-tier mutation requirement does not apply. The body records the author's text-cache mutation as red and the restored reader as green. I did not repeat that mutation because this review must not change code. The unmodified regression passed locally.

Goldens moved: none. No recorded program changed.

Requested before merge: none.

Full heavy lanes, GUI tests, Windows tests, and Linux tests were not run. The review worktree and branch remain in place to preserve the build cache. The tracked tree is clean.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

HOLD (merge sweep): the counted review at e0b968e is real, but the reviewed main has moved well past the review base and this merge needs a fresh merged-tree build to pass check 5. The host is under load (and the coordinator's directive caps builds while the kernel gate and runner job are active). Skipping this merge; re-check after the builds go idle. Fresh trial build owed on the new base: `git worktree add .claude/worktrees/trials-4078 origin/main`, merge, `-j 6`.
